Rashid: Heads-up — a modest spike in SSE reconnects at 2026-09-02T08:12Z, but console classifies them as 'unexpected'. Traces show they originate during route rebinds when the route_policy changes priority. Anyone seen this pattern? :mag:

meera: Confirmed. Edge logs: keepalive returned 200 then resume fails with `resume_mismatch` within ~120ms because `route_priority` flipped. Clients treat the 200 as terminal.

kai: Interesting difference from other incidents — this one correlates with an autoscaler bump that changed routing weights, not a slab drain. So it's a routing policy update race.

ara: Can we add `route_policy_change=true` in the proxy logs and a header `X-Route-Policy: transitioning` when policy commits are in-flight? That would let client libs keep resume tokens across soft acks.

meera: Sample sanitized log:
```
2026-09-02T08:12:03.002Z route=svc-auth old_priority=10 new_priority=5 session=shft1 conn_keepalive=200
2026-09-02T08:12:03.118Z route=svc-auth resume_attempt=1 resume_ok=false reason="resume_mismatch" route_policy_change_id=cp_47
```

kai: For billing: these reconnects got billed as new sessions. We should add a short metering grace window (300ms) keyed by resume_token to avoid churn billing for routing-policy handoffs. Make opt-in per account.

billing-bot: flagged potential duplicate charges: ~720 events in 6m window; created ticket BILL-2026-211 (P3).

Rashid: Console UX request: when a reconnect alert fires surface `route_policy_change_id`, active routing diff (old->new priority), and the autoscaler event id. Right now alerts lack rollout/routing context.

meera: Also suggest a new panel `reconnect_by_policy_commit` that correlates `route_policy_change=true` logs with `conn_keepalive` and `resume_ok` over time. Add grouping by `route_policy_change_id` so we can pivot to exact policy commit.

ara: I'll add the header + structured log keys: `route_policy_change=true`, `route_policy_change_id`, `handoff_hint=policy` behind an env toggle. Will include small unit test. ETA 50m.

kai: DevEx: we should document that client libs should treat `X-Route-Policy: transitioning` as resume-friendly and retain resume_token across a soft ok. Also include a sample fallback: if resume fails twice within 1s, do not bill as new session immediately.

Rashid: Action list: 1) @ara implement header+logs PR, 2) @meera add dashboard panel & alert enrichment, 3) @kai prototype resume-based meter grace opt-in, 4) DevEx publish client guidance + update rollout docs.

console-bot: note: created dashboard task DASH-2026-88 for `reconnect_by_policy_commit` panel.

Rashid: Thanks. If we see corner-case churn I'll pause policy rollouts until logs+dashboards are live.
